## Privacy And Safety Check

- [ ] No real session notes were added.
- [ ] No identifiable personal information was added.
- [ ] No real psychological profile, medical history, or risk-event detail was added.
- [ ] Examples are fictional or generic.
- [ ] Public files are written in English, except localized README files.

## Verification

- [ ] Documentation links work.
- [ ] Template filenames are correct.
- [ ] No unintended private material is present.
- [ ] If visuals are included, they were reviewed for project relevance and clarity before publishing.
